RESPONSIBILITY AND COMPLIANCE STATEMENT

Dataset: Household energy use survey, 2025 wave.
Depositor: Centre for Social Research.

The survey was administered in person across 1,240 households. Each record holds
the respondent's full name, date of birth, home address, household income band,
and the meter readings collected during the visit. Interviewers recorded their
own staff number alongside each entry.

Ethics approval REC-2025-003 was granted. Participants gave consent for use of
their responses in research analysis. Consent was not sought for publication of
individual records. Applicable jurisdiction: France.
